args.body:
Hi Litware Ltd,

We're sorry your hardware was shipped to the wrong site. We've corrected your registered shipping site in our system to **Pune DC** (per your contract record) and refunded the **310** reshipping fee to your original payment method. You should see it within a few business days.

Ticket C-1724 is now closed. If you need anything else, just reply to this email.

Thanks,
IT Operations
